env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^nums:123 <nil>$'
stdout '^words:ab <nil>$'
stdout '^exact-int$'
stdout '^tilde-int$'
stdout '^other$'
stdout '^keep: <nil>$'
cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
grep 'switch any\(\(\*T\)\(nil\)\)\.\(type\)' out/main.go
grep 'case \*int64:' out/main.go
grep 'Reinterpret\[\[\]int64\]\(&items\)' out/main.go
grep 'any\(v\)\.\(io\.WriterTo\)\.WriteTo' out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..
cd out
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectconstswitch

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"strconv"
)

func EncodeSlice[T any](buf []byte, items []T) ([]byte, error) {
	const switch T {
	case int64:
		for _, v := range items {
			buf = strconv.AppendInt(buf, v, 10)
		}
		return buf, nil
	case io.WriterTo:
		var b bytes.Buffer
		for _, v := range items {
			v.WriteTo(&b)?
		}
		return append(buf, b.Bytes()...), nil
	}
	return buf, nil
}

type Word struct {
	S string
}

func (w Word) WriteTo(dst io.Writer) (int64, error) {
	n, err := dst.Write([]byte(w.S))
	return int64(n), err
}

type UserID int

func describe[T any](v T) string {
	const switch T {
	case int:
		return "exact-int"
	case ~int:
		return "tilde-int"
	}
	return "other"
}

func main() {
	b, err := EncodeSlice([]byte("nums:"), []int64{1, 2, 3})
	fmt.Printf("%s %v\n", b, err)
	b, err = EncodeSlice([]byte("words:"), []Word{{"a"}, {"b"}})
	fmt.Printf("%s %v\n", b, err)
	fmt.Println(describe(3))
	fmt.Println(describe(UserID(3)))
	fmt.Println(describe("s"))
	kept, kerr := EncodeOrKeep([]byte("keep:"), []string{"x", "y"})
	fmt.Printf("%s %v\n", kept, kerr)
}

func EncodeOrKeep[T any](buf []byte, items []T) ([]byte, error) {
	const switch T {
	case int64:
		for _, v := range items {
			buf = strconv.AppendInt(buf, v, 10)
		}
		return buf, nil
	case io.WriterTo:
		var b bytes.Buffer
		for _, v := range items {
			v.WriteTo(&b)?
		}
		return append(buf, b.Bytes()...), nil
	}
	return buf, nil
}
